newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Capital Intelligence cautions on Thai banks.
newsitem.headline: Capital Intelligence cautions on Thai banks.

text.p: Cyprus-based bank rating agency Capital Intelligence said it has assigned negative outlooks to all Thai banks.

"While the Thai economy is still growing at a brisk pace, overall the operating environment prevailing in the banking sector has become less favourable and the changes in the outlooks reflect this negative development," the agency said.
Growth in exports and gross domestic product is slowing and the future of the coalition government looks increasingly uncertain.

Thai banks have relied increasingly in recent years on foreign borrowings to fund their loan portfolios. "A sudden reversal of the flow because of loss in investors' confidence could destabilise the money market, leading to a liquidty crunch and swings in interest rates, complicating the banks' asset and liability management," the agency said.
